Relative links such as '../../../user-reference/...' in arras-session-definitions.md point outside the vendored subtree and are left unmodified.

Internal cross-references between developer-reference pages use extensionless Jekyll permalinks (e.g. '(source-structure)') and are left unmodified; the target files exist in this vendored tree under the same name with a .md extension.
